[[Ziinjuu's Sanctuary]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Ziinjuu Life Crawler]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sunqua Vale]].

==Stats==
: [[Energy]] +5
: [[Holy damage|Holy Dmg]]: 7-10 (Requires 5 [[Smiting Prayers]])
: [[HCT|Halves casting time]] of Smiting Prayers spells (Chance: 10%)
: [[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of spells (Chance: 20%)
: [[Health]] +10

*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] OR [[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
